title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper
tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

faults.what: The supplied audio report identifies speech, “Bardzo dziękuję,” despite the explicit request for no sound; the reported peak is extremely low at -78.3 dB.

judge.summary: The wallpaper visually matches the requested glowing ribbons and dark clock area, but reported speech violates the silence requirement and the seamless loop cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
must_haves.why: The clip is reported as eight seconds, and the supplied frames show a full-frame portrait wallpaper consistent with 9:16, without visible letterboxing.

must_haves.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
must_haves.why: Soft luminous blue and purple ribbons change their flowing positions across the sampled frames against a black background, consistent with slow movement.

must_haves.item: The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
must_haves.why: Every supplied frame leaves the upper third black and empty, with the glowing ribbons concentrated in the lower portion.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
must_haves.why: The samples at one, three, five and seven seconds do not show the end-to-start transition.

must_haves.item: There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
must_haves.why: No text, clock graphics or interface elements are visible in any supplied frame.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Although the reported peak is extremely low, the supplied sound transcription explicitly reports heard speech: “Bardzo dziękuję.”
